
func TestQAEmptyPoolCancellationBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 backend := NewMockBackend()
 cfg := &Config{ClientMaxCount: 1, ClientBufSize: 128, ClientRetryTimes: 1, MaxTimeout: time.Second,
  ClientFactory: func() (logservice.Client, error) { return newMockBackendClient(backend), nil }}
 pool := newClientPool(cfg)
 t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
 held, err := pool.Get()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 d := &LogServiceDriver{clientPool: pool, config: *cfg}
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Millisecond)
 defer cancel()
 done := make(chan error, 1)
 go func() { _, e := d.getTruncatedPSNFromBackend(ctx); done <- e }()
 <-ctx.Done()
 select { case e := <-done: t.Fatalf("pool unexpectedly returned before release: %v", e); case <-time.After(100*time.Millisecond): }
 pool.Put(held)
 select { case e := <-done: require.Error(t, e); require.ErrorIs(t, ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
 case <-time.After(time.Second): t.Fatal("request did not finish after client released") }
}
